_help: Problem reports -> GitHub Issues. Deploy build/report-worker.js on Cloudflare Workers (free), then paste the worker URL here. Empty = students use 'Copy report'.

messages.text:
START and RESET press by themselves and stop every command.
1) 🔄 Update → ⬆ Update robot.
2) Ask the teacher to remove the VMX HiCurrDIO jumper.
3) Test Simple tasks again → 📨 Send results.

Wheels can't move: the robot can't find the Titan.
Check: E-STOP up · POWER on · Titan lights on · CAN cable (yellow/green) VMX → Titan plugged in both ends.
Then 🔄 Update → ⬆ Update robot, and ask the teacher about the VMX jumper (START/RESET always pressed).

_help_messages: Messages shown on the student page. to = all, or the end of the robot Wi-Fi name (Team-1). Change id to show a message again.
